title: Report/audit packet expansion for providers, filings, ETF docs and candles
decision: The final audit packet export includes provider, identity, conflict, ledger, score/history, filing, ETF disclosure, news, candle and configuration evidence; unavailable optional sources are explicit and external audit responses remain non-executable.
limitations: SEC/ESEF/PRIIPs/index-methodology provider workflows remain open; this record closes the packet contract and unavailable policy, not those parsers.
Chrome visual evidence is used; Windows Computer Use was not counted as a pass.
